ar_static.desc: AR-style write-once calibration frozen at step 0. Models dropping an off-the-shelf KV quantizer onto a dLLM; expected to degrade.

ar_static_hadamard.desc: AR-static + Hadamard rotation (RotateKV/KVLinC-style outlier smoothing), still frozen calibration.

fresh_per_step.desc: Recalibrate fully every step — accurate but the most expensive; an oracle-ish reference for the gap.

dkv_step_aware.desc: PROPOSED: EMA step-aware recalibration using the dLLM's warm-step recomputation as a free calibration probe.

dkv_step_aware_hadamard.desc: PROPOSED + Hadamard rotation: step-aware EMA on rotated channels for the strongest outlier handling.
